details.values: Starts near 1800 at time step 0, gradually rises with fluctuations to about 5200 at time step 2600, with notable dips around 1500 and 2200 time steps.

elements.summary: This line plot shows the SP500 index values over a series of time steps, illustrating the upward trend and fluctuations in the index over time. The x-axis uses time steps rather than actual dates, and the y-axis shows the index value.
